We decided to keep the free plan. Ana Okafor made the call on 2026-10-01, according to the decisions log.

**Why:**
- 38% of paid households started on the free plan, so it feeds paid conversion.
- Students asked for it in the October survey.

**Limit:** The free plan stays capped at 2 lists.
